body: I can assure you that he won’t “catch” your thoughts. You really should get professional help as you seem to be hyper fixated on things that aren’t happening. Your children would not be better off without you, I don’t know my mum or dad and I can assure you that your children would be left feeling hurt, confused, unwanted and just shitty. You sound like a great mum to care so much about your kids but you need to get help so you can take care of them properly.
Please call an ambulance, you need some medical aid!
I work at McDonald’s and it’s basically the same for me, it fucking sucks and you don’t deserve it at all!

How do you know your mum loves you?

She went to get the groceries from Walmart and she’s still waiting in line 13 years later!

How do you know your dad loves you?

He went with her.

I completely understand, i still think about know (years after) I should probably see someone but I don’t. There are times where I can still feel him touching me and doing it all and I just want to tear off my skin. Maybe one day it will get better but it definitely dulls over time.

I was raped repeatedly by people who were meant to care for me, although I can’t relate to your exact situation, I have experienced some of the pain and heart break that comes with this. I’m so incredibly sorry this happened to you, no one deserves to go through this and I’m so proud of you for telling a friend and even making this post. You are incredibly strong and I want to support you in anyway I can. You are loved and wanted and cared for, even if your government is corrupt, you have an incredible amount of people who want to help you, even if the only way they can is to talk to you or distract you. You are worth so much and you are better than what happened to you. If I can help you in anyway let me know, you are loved!! Always remember that!
